title: Ayrton Senna Personal Talk: Message for the Future
native_title: アイルトン・セナ パーソナルトーク
overview:
Message for the future

Senna's thoughts are now revived as a message for the future...

Supervised by Yoshitoshi Sakurai, former Honda F1 team general manager and president of Racing Club International.

Ayrton Senna Personal Talk is a multimedia sports documentary built around Formula One driver Ayrton Senna in his own words. At its heart is "Personal Talk", a collection of Sakurai's interviews with Senna arranged by year, spoken in English with Japanese subtitles over accompanying visuals.

- Personal Talk: year-by-year interviews with Japanese subtitles
- Saying and Flash Back: selected messages from Senna
- Three memorial piano pieces to listen to, in stereo or mono

Message for the future

セナの想いが未来へのメッセージとして今、蘇る・・・。

元ホンダF1チーム総監督／レーシング・クラブ・インターナショナル代表
桜井淑敏氏監修
